NOT quantized (q_box_logits=false): box logits leave the accelerator as wide values

NOT quantized (q_boxes=false): anchor decode and stride scaling run in the FP32 postprocessor; no k-bit box store

conformant.name: conformant
notes: box logits leave the accelerator as wide values (no k-bit store of the 64-channel box-distribution logits); the softmax and expectation run on them and are requantized

the joins re-store only the score group (boxes are not a k-bit store) with the signed codebook, as engine.analyze defines a join (never non-negative); the scores are thus unsigned k-bit codes after the sigmoid and signed k-bit codes after each join
bfp6 and mxfp8_e4m3: default_fp32_box_logits (no join store), because block formats store a join only as a whole 84-channel tensor

differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: none: the folded FP32 bias is used unchanged
differences_from_classifier_default.why: leave-one-out arm better on dev128 with an interval excluding zero (rule of addendum 1)

differences_from_classifier_default.classifier_default: fused_relu (clamps only; Hardswish and Hardsigmoid unfused)
differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: a convolution that feeds only SiLU keeps the wide accumulator; SiLU is evaluated on the wide value and requantized once: a wide-precision nonlinearity or a large table, instead of a k-bit code-to-code table
differences_from_classifier_default.why: passed the 0.5-point test of the protocol on dev128

differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: fewer requantizers, nothing added; a concatenation still requantizes its inputs to one scale
differences_from_classifier_default.why: the two extra operators do not exist in the classifiers; no arithmetic happens in them

differences_from_classifier_default.detector: input image, sigmoid scores and box expectation only
differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: the first convolution has an unsigned k-bit activation operand; all other operands are signed
differences_from_classifier_default.why: same rule (provably non-negative boundaries); SiLU outputs are not non-negative

differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: anchor decode and stride scaling run in the wide (FP32) postprocessor on the dequantized box expectation; no k-bit store of pixel coordinates and no 84-channel k-bit tensor
differences_from_classifier_default.why: decoded boxes: test met on dev128, +2.16 [+1.50, +3.30] (cum5_q_boxes -> cum5_weight_mse). Joins: PROTOCOL DEVIATION. No arm tested the join exemption before the freeze, so the written rule keeps the joins quantized; the exemption was adopted with the box exemption. Measured afterwards: +0.19 [+0.08, +0.43] (default_q_joins -> default), test not met.

differences_from_classifier_default.classifier_default: does not exist (classifier logits are k-bit codes)
differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: the accelerator emits k-bit box-expectation codes and k-bit score codes; NMS compares score codes, so equal scores are frequent and the tie rule is part of the contract
differences_from_classifier_default.switch: head: projection constant, box expectation, sigmoid scores, box and class logits
differences_from_classifier_default.why: projection constant, box expectation and sigmoid scores: putting each back did not meet the test on dev128. Class logits: exemption +0.36 [-0.07, +0.73] (cum5_weight_mse -> cum5_fp32_class_logits), test not met. Box logits: PROTOCOL DEVIATION. Exemption +0.56 [+0.21, +0.87] (cum5_weight_mse -> cum5_fp32_box_logits) met the test before the freeze (bootstrap 19:57:51, frozen.py 20:04:01); the first agent had classed the logit exemptions as diagnostics and kept the box logits quantized.

differences_from_classifier_default.classifier_default: not covered by the classifier default
differences_from_classifier_default.detector: block semantics of tools/experiment_b_ext/shared.py unchanged; boundary and head switches apply; range rules, pass-through and unsigned do not
differences_from_classifier_default.hardware: as v1 block formats, with the fused SiLU boundary and without box/join stores
differences_from_classifier_default.why: the block scale is computed at run time (block max-abs covering power of two)
